plugins.description: Normify · DSH 插件：把项目架构写成归一化的分形模块树，三层校验（写时 / 校验 / 冻结回执）、30 个 normify_* 工具 + normify-gen 技能，一键渲染单文件交互式架构图；支持伴随式开发（change_open → brief → check → 实施 → refresh → change_close）。
plugins.readme_text:
English · 简体中文

Normify · 归一化框架图构建器

把整个项目描述成一棵"人机共读"的分形模块树：AI 负责分析与创作，确定性引擎负责校验、编译与渲染 —— 点开任意模块，就是一张更精细的子图。

--- ## 0. 一句话 Normify 是 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件**，也是**一套写给 AI 用的开发流程**： - **给 AI 的**：`normify-gen` 技能 + **31 个 `normify_*` 工具** —— 让模型把仓库分析成模块树结构数据， 并在后续开发中**先建图后编程、伴随编程改图**（计划态建树 → 逐个实现 → 关单收尾）。 - **给引擎的**：零容忍校验（L1 写时 / L2 全项目 / L3 冻结）+ 确定性编译（`tree.json` 等四件产物，SHA-256 冻结） + 渲染数据（`renders/`，决定"每一层怎么画"）。 - **给人的**：**单文件交互式架构图**（`normify.html`）—— 逐层下钻、悬停看介绍、一键中英切换、深链接、 多树、**API 直连箭头**、跨层聚合、缩放与搜索。零依赖，双击即开。 > 它不是"生成一张图就结束"的工具：结构数据与代码**互为契约**，每次改动都能被 `normify_sync` 检出漂移， > 并以 `normify_change_close`（**0 error 强制**）收尾，让"代码 → 架构图"永远同步。


引擎层：14 个模块、API 直连箭头（箭头锚定到具体 API 行）、带标签的子系统依赖、跨层聚合虚线

## 1. 它解决什么问题 | 痛点 | Normify 的做法 | | --- | --- | | 架构图一画完就过期 | 结构数据是**可校验的源数据**：`normify_sync` 按 `fingerprint` 检出漂移，`normify_change_close` 强制 0 error 收尾 | | 图太粗，看不出接口契约 | 粒度到**单一功能单元**，API 写在叶子上，箭头可锚定到具体 API（`from_api`/`to_api`） | | AI 改代码时"看不见全局" | `normify_brief` 给出目标模块契约、影响面（谁依赖我）、规则约束与验收清单 | | 设计先写代码后补文档，必然漂移 | **计划态先建树**（`state: planned`）→ 实现后 `normify_module_refresh(activate)` 自动转 active | | 结构规范靠人自觉 | `policy.yml` 架构规则（依赖方向 / 禁依赖 / 无环 / 深度 / 跨树 / 命名）由 `validate` 强制执行 | | 大仓库一次生成太重 | 增量再生成：只重建受影响子树，`layouts_to_review` 点名要复核的层 | ## 2. 核心特性 ### 2.1 数据模型：分形 + 零冗余 - **唯一元素**：整个数据库由无数个结构完全相同的**基本模块**构成（每个模块 = 一个 Markdown 文件）。 - **只存 `parent`**：单方向引用，`children` 由索引导出 —— 不会出现"父子各说各话"。 - **API 只在叶子存一次**：聚合、统计、索引全部是编译期派生数据（`tree.json` / `api-index.json`）。 - **两类边**：containment（树边，导航骨架）+ dependency（箭头，可跨子树、跨树，按 `kind` 着色）。 - **路径式 id + 不变 uid**：AI 沿 id 逐层定位（类二分查找）；`uid` 在改名/移动时保持不变，git diff 稳定。 - **深度不设上限**（0.5.0 起）：想有多细就拆多细，深度不再成为"合并模块"的理由。 ### 2.2 三层校验，fail-closed | 层 | 时机 | 内容 | | --- | --- | --- | | **L1** | 每次写入 | 必填字段、id 文法、uid、parent 一致性、双语长度、source/apis/deps 形状、state/replacement | | **L2** | `normify_validate` | 全项目：唯一性、文件↔id 映射、叶子/非叶子规则、API 键唯一、依赖目标、环、渲染数据交叉校验、架构规则、变更日志、（可选）仓库证据（source 存在性 + 指纹一致） | | **L3** | `normify_build` | 任何 error 都不产出产物；产出即 SHA-256 冻结进 `receipt.json` | 每条诊断都带 `severity / code / message / subject / evidence / supportedFixes` —— **AI 可自行修复**。 ### 2.3 渲染器：单文件、可下钻、API 直连 - 单文件 HTML（内联 CSS/JS，**零外部依赖**、零遥测），双击即开，可直接归档/发人。 - 逐层下钻 + 面包屑 + 搜索（模块名/API）+ 大纲视图 + API 浏览器。 - **API 直连**：叶子框内展示 API 明细行，箭头锚定到具体 API 行的端口；同一 API 行上的多条边自动扇形分离。 - 跨层依赖聚合为虚线 `×N`（默认隐藏，工具栏或 `?agg=1` 开启，悬停看明细）。 - 深链接：`#module=`、`#api=`、`#view=outline`、`?lang=zh|en`、`?agg=1`；缩放 / 悬停高亮 / 明暗主题。 - **几何自检**：仓库自带 `check-geometry.mjs`，逐层断言"线不出界 / 不贴框 / 不穿框 / 不压线"。 ### 2.4 伴随开发：先建图后编程 ``` change_open → brief → check → module_batch(state=planned) → 【写代码】 → module_refresh(activate) → change_close(0 error 强制) → verified + revision.after ``` - **计划态**：源码还不存在也能先建树（`fingerprint: pending`），`validate` 放行； - **禁止假激活**：源码没落地就 `activate` 直接被拒； - **收尾即闭环**：`change_close` 会刷新指纹 → 校验（0 error 强制）→ 编译（可选渲染）→ 标记 `verified`， 任何一步失败都不关闭，变更保持原状态； - **改图随代码**：`normify_sync` 用 `git diff` + 未跟踪文件定位受影响模块与指纹漂移，`module_patch` 跟随更新。 ### 2.5 架构规则先行（policy.yml） | 规则 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `dependency-direction` | 层顺序即允许的依赖方向（如 plugin → tools → engine），可控制同层是否允许 | | `forbid-dependency` | 禁止某些 from → to 的依赖（可按 kind / state 过滤） | | `acyclic` | 依赖图禁止成环（可含跨树） | | `max-depth` | id 段数上限（**可选**：不写就是不限，0.5.0 起默认不限） | | `cross-tree` | 跨树依赖策略：`forbid` / `allow` / `require-to-api` | | `naming` | 作用域内 id 段的命名正则 | 安装后 `normify_validate` / `normify_build` / `normify_check` 全部强制执行；**违规先改设计，不能绕过**。 ## 3. 最新变化 ### v0.5.4 · 把"第二轮 A/B 实测"暴露的 4 个工具缺陷修掉（当前版本） 第二轮 A/B 换了题目（**表格公式引擎 + CLI**，同一份规范、隐藏黑盒 88 项、外加**差分模糊测试**）。 两组最终 B 88/88、A 87/88（差异只有一条 §5.2 语义）；这一版修的是**工具侧**新暴露的 4 个坑： - **`mode:"patch"` 的静默 no-op 被拦下**：原来 `items:[{patch:{id, tags:[...]}}]`（少一层包装）会返回 `ok:true, count:1` 却**一个字段都没改**——最危险的"假成功"。现在直接报 `args/invalid-patch`， evidence 里给出收到的键与正确形状 `{patch:{id, patch:{...}}}`；单模块 `normify_module_patch` 传空补丁 同样报 `args/empty-patch`（只给 `expect_updated_at` 也不再静默通过）。 - **`normify_module_refresh` 不再强依赖 git**：`repoRoot` 不是 git 仓库时，以前直接 `refresh/git-failed` 失败（实测中 AI 只能 `git init` 才能激活模块）。现在改成**降级**：指纹照常重算、 `state` 照常激活，`revision` 保持模块原值，并给出 `refresh/git-unavailable` 警告与修法。 - **`change_open` 的 `acceptance` 报错具体化**：以前把 `{zh,en}` 写进 acceptance 只有一句笼统报错； 现在明确写出"**第 N 条不是非空字符串（收到 …）：验收标准只接受纯字符串**"，并提示双语描述写进 `title`/`intent`。 - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic:"tool:<工具名>"`**：`tools` 主题现在每个工具都带**必填/可选**摘要， 新主题可按需打印**完整参数树**（类型 / 描述 / 必填，由注册表实时生成、与运行时校验同源）。 实测里 AI 为确认 `mode=patch` 的嵌套形状去读了插件源码——这条主题正是为了消灭这种绕路。 ### v0.5.3 · 把「伴随编程实测」暴露的 4 个摩擦点修掉 这四个问题来自一次真实的 A/B 对照实验：两个 AI 用同一份规范写同一个后端，一个带插件走伴随流程、一个纯手写 （最终代码在隐藏黑盒验收上都是 **42/42**）。插件组多交付了 41 模块 / 110 API / 10 层的结构数据，但也踩到了下面 4 个坑： - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic`**：此前它完全忽略入参，只返回同一份字段速查 —— 实测里 AI 为了拿准 `change_open` / `layout_upsert` / `change_close` 的参数名，只能去读插件源码（多花约 4 分钟）。 现在按主题返回：`fields`（默认）/ `deps`（箭头与 API 直连）/ `renders` / `flow`（伴随流程）/ `tools`（工具清单）/ `policy` / `errors`（常见诊断码与修法）/ `all`；**传错主题会直接报错并列出可用主题**，不再静默忽略。 - **项目初始化通道**：新增第 31 个工具 `normify_project_init` —— 建 `normify-/` + 默认架构规则， 可选 `root` 一步创建"计划态根模块"（幂等）；同时 `normify_change_open` 现在也会**自动建项目目录** （此前报 `project/no-modules`，AI 只能用 `module_batch {items:[],dry_run:true}` 绕过去）； `normify_brief` 遇到不存在的模块会给出"先 init / 先建树 / 改用 task"的可执行提示。 - **批量诊断的因果链**：一条 `label-too-long` 曾连带出 3 条 `dep/target-missing`（因为 L1 失败的模块会被移出批次工作集）， AI 只能去读源码才能确认根因。现在连带错误改报 `dep/target-dropped` / `structure/parent-dropped`， 在 message 与 evidence 里点明**根因诊断码**，并在失败响应的 `root_causes` 里直接列出被丢弃的模块（附 `hint`）。 - **「API 直连」引导**：两端都声明了 API 却没写 `from_api` / `to_api` 的箭头，`normify_validate` 会给出**聚合** warning `dep/unanchored`（条数 + 前 3 条示例）。这正是实验里被浪费的能力：110 条 API 声明，54 条箭头 0 条锚定 —— 不锚定，箭头就只能落在框边，钉不到 API 行上。**引导≠放宽**：锚错键仍然是 error。 ### v0.5.2 · 修掉三处会写坏数据的真实缺陷 - **`normify_module_upsert` 的必填表不再丢失**：`parameters.required` 恢复为 `["frontmatter"]`， `frontmatter` 的 9 个必填字段（uid / id / parent / name / description / source / revision / updated_at / fingerprint） 也重新出现在 schema 里。此前嵌套 schema 被二次编译，必填表被整段丢掉 —— 模型看到的约束与运行时实际校验不一致。 - **`normify_module_move` 迁移渲染数据时重写内容**：`id` / `order` / `groups.children` / `edge_hints` 全部改写到新 id， 并同步维护**旧父级**（删掉已迁出子模块的引用）与**新父级**（把新 id 补进 `order`）。 修复前：move 完之后项目立刻被 L2 判为 `layout/id-mismatch` + `layout/order-child` 等（实测 8–9 个 error，0.5.2 后为 0）。 - **晋升为容器时不再把 API 留在容器上**：叶子被晋升（显式 `normify_module_promote`、写子模块自动晋升、move 到叶子底下） 时，容器上残留的 `apis` 会被摘除，并回报 `structure/api-dropped-on-promote` 警告（附丢失的 API 键清单）—— 修复前项目会直接卡在 `api/non-leaf`。 - **API 默认全展开**：渲染数据字段 `max_api_rows` 缺省 **0 = 全部展开**，叶子上的 API 一行不折叠；需要收窄时显式写 1..48。 - 三处缺陷各自配了回归断言：`tests/regression-0.5.2.mjs`（34 项，全绿）。 ### v0.5.1 · 渲染器防重叠（线压线 12 → 0） - **修复连线共线重叠**：28 层合计 **12 处 → 0 处**。四处根因： ① 首选路由只判"不穿别人的框"，从不检查是否压到已画的线 → 改为只接受 `violations === 0` 的候选； ② API 锚定端口没有端口分离（同一 API 行被多条边共用） → 行内 ±5.5px 扇形分离； ③ API 端口落在上下边时被放进框内部 → 上下边退回按边均匀分离； ④ `segClear` 整块跳过源/目标框 → 新增"进入自身框内部"检查（内缩 2px）。 - 节点/分组间距 170 → 220，给密集层更多自由通道。 ### v0.5.0 · 取消模块数量上限 - **删除 `MAX_DEPTH = 12`** 硬限制：树可以一直下钻到"单一功能单元"；需要限层时用 `policy.yml` 的 `max-depth` 规则显式声明（`maxDepth` 放宽到 1..64）。 - SKILL：目标深度改为"不设上限"，单批上限 40 → 200，新增"每叶 API 尽量 3–5 条"的粒度指引。
更早的版本（v0.4.x / v0.3 / v0.2 / v0.1） - **v0.4.1**：渲染器 v3 定稿（自由通道走线、viewBox 全几何自适应、API 直连、跨层聚合、缩放与悬停）； `normify_sync` 识别**未跟踪的新文件**（`git ls-files --others`）。 - **v0.4.0**：伴随开发（`state: pla

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-hot-reload

标题、简介、图标和浏览器模块都按磁盘现读现发布：改完立即生效，不用重启 DSH。

A DeepSeek Harness bundle. It replaces three cached resolvers with plain filesystem
walks, so a plugin's display metadata and browser module follow the package on disk
instead of a verdict cached for the life of the process:

| Service | Why it is patched |
| --- | --- |
| `pluginPackages.metaOf` | The Host resolves `locale/*.json` and `icon.svg` through the Node ESM resolver. A package whose export was added after its first read stays bare until restart. |
| `pluginManager.listBundles` | The plugin inventory calls the Host reader directly, so it needs the same disk result even when the Host already produced a fallback. |
| `clientModules.resolveMeta` / `locatePkgJson` | Verdicts are cached in `pkgMeta`, `null` included. Moving a linked package makes its browser half disappear. |

Install it into a profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add <path-to-this-checkout>
```

Editing another plugin's `locale/`, `icon.svg`, or manifest then needs only a page
refresh. Editing this plugin's own `index.js`, or adding a new importable subpath
export, still needs a restart: Node caches modules by URL.

## Test

```powershell
$env:DSH_RUNTIME = '<dsh-runtime>'
$env:DSH_PROFILE_DIR = '<profile-dir>'
node test/live.test.mjs
```

The check compares this reader against the Host reader for every package the profile
depends on, and reproduces the late-locale case.

plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

## Three things worth knowing before you edit this

Each of these cost real

plugins.description: Hide unused models, rename them, keep the billing rate visible — a model list manager for DeepSeek Harness. 隐藏用不到的模型、给模型改备注名、保留厂商计费倍率。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-model-tidy

**中文** · [English](README.en.md) · [日本語](README.ja.md) · [Русский](README.ru.md)

一个让 DeepSeek Harness 的模型选择器保持整洁的插件——决定哪些模型出现、给它们起你认得的名字，并保住厂商标注的计费倍率。

![模型整理设置页](docs/screenshots/main.png)

## 它解决的问题

装两三个 provider 插件，模型菜单就变成一堵墙。一条免费车道、一个工作台 App、两个自己配的网关，转眼三十来项——大多数你根本不会选，还有几个是同一模型走了不同渠道的近似重复项。

模型选择器是**做决定的地方，不是仓库**。它应该只摆你真正在用的那几个，用你认得的名字。

## 它做什么

安装后，DSH 设置里会出现「**模型整理**」分区。模型按来源渠道分组，每一项各带一个开关：

```
┌─ WorkBuddy ───────────── 8/12 ─ [恢复默认排序] [隐藏全部] [显示全部] ─┐
│ ▲▼  Auto                                            ●───              │
│ ▲▼  GLM-5.3 · x0.79                                 ●───              │
│ ▲▼  GLM-5.2 · x0.79 · 夜间折扣          [改备注]    ───●              │
│ ▲▼  Grok-4.7 · x1.90                                ───●              │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
┌─ our-free-model ───────── 6/6 ── [恢复默认排序] [隐藏全部] [显示全部] ─┐
│ ▲▼  Kilo Auto Free                                  ●───              │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

- **每个模型一个开关**：关掉即从模型选择器消失，打开即回来。
- **上下箭头排序**：调整模型在列表里的先后，渠道头可一键恢复默认顺序。
- **备注名**：给模型起个你认得的名字，选择器就以它显示；厂商的计费后缀会原样留在末尾。
- **搜索**：按模型名、渠道或备注名过滤。
- **渠道级批量**：一键隐藏或显示某个渠道的全部模型。
- **全局显示 / 隐藏**：两个按钮作用于整个目录。
- **恢复**：一个按钮清空全部备注，另一个让全部模型回来。

## 自定义排序

每个模型左侧有一对箭头，用来调整它在所属渠道内的先后顺序。排序是**显式保存**的：调完重启 DSH、换一台机器同步配置，顺序都还在。

- **只影响排列，不影响可见性**：排过序的模型被隐藏后，它的位置记在保存的顺序里；重新显示时回到原来的位置。
- **新模型排在你排过的那些之后**：渠道以后上架新模型，不会插进你精心安排的那一段中间。
- **搜索时可以继续排序**：筛选状态下点箭头，交换的是**当前可见的相邻两项**，所以点一下就能看到变化；被筛掉的模型保持它自己的相对位置。
- **一键回退**：渠道头的「恢复默认排序」清掉该渠道的自定义顺序，回到目录原本的排列。

排序记录在插件自己的设置命名空间里（`order` 字段，按渠道存一组模型 id），不改动任何渠道配置。


## 改备注不会弄丢倍率

厂商把计费倍率拼在模型的**显示名**里——`GLM-5.3 · x0.79`——因为 harness 的模型目录没有倍率字段。直接替换这个名字（大多数改名的做法）会把倍率一并丢掉。

本插件按厂商自己的分隔符切开名字，并保留后半段：

| | 选择器里显示的名字 |
|---|---|
| 厂商原名 | `GLM-5.3 · x0.79` |
| 改备注为「GLM 便宜」 | **`GLM 便宜 · x0.79`** |
| 带促销标签时改备注 | **`GLM 便宜 · x0.79 · 夜间折扣`** |
| 本身没有倍率的模型 | `自动` ← 不会多出分隔符 |

## 隐藏一个模型不会让它跑位

被隐藏的模型不在目录里（harness 会把它过滤掉），所以它的行只能靠保存下来的信息重建。**顺理成章地把行追加到末尾，会让它一被隐藏就跳到分组底部**。本插件记住每一行首次出现的位置，所以隐藏五个里的第三个，它仍然排在第三。

## 它刻意不做的事

**整理是显示层的决定，绝不是配置改动。**

- 不重写你的渠道配置。隐藏列表与备注表只存在本插件自己的设置命名空间里。
- 正在使用某模型的会话不受影响——路由按模型 id 走，改的只是显示名。
- 卸载插件后列表完全恢复原样。
- 渠道新上架的模型默认可见。本插件记录的是「要隐藏什么、要改什么名」，从不是「要显示什么」。

## 覆盖范围

开关作用于**所有**模型来源，不限于手工配置的渠道。插件过滤的是 harness 自己的目录枚举——`ctx.llm.listModels`，也就是每个界面都会读的那一份列表。其他插件通过 `ctx.llm.registerAdapter` 注册的模型、以及 `llm-pi-ai` 下声明的渠道，都落在这一份列表里，因此都被覆盖。

行按 **渠道 + 模型** 作键，所以同一模型名经两条路由进来仍是两行独立控制：`workbuddy/gemini-3.8-flash` 与 `gemini/gemini-3.8-flash` 是不同的上游服务，各有各的开关和备注。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add dsh-model-tidy
```

然后重新打开 DSH Web GUI，设置导航里会出现「**模型整理**」。

## 开发

无需构建：两半都以 harness 直接加载的原始文件形式发布。宿主半是 ES 模块；浏览器半是 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` 工厂——客户端模块系统调用的格式。

```sh
npm test
```

一次跑完九套测试：目录过滤器、倍率后缀切分、浏览器半行为、备注后缀抓取、行序保持、自定义排序、排序渲染、渲染结构，以及与另一个包装同一个方法的插件共存。

`npm run check:packaging` 校验客户端依赖声明指向的包在 harness 中真实存在。

## 兼容性

针对 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 开发。要求 DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.1`——该版本起设置层才提供本插件分区写入所用的 `configForms` 服务。

## 许可证

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-market-console —— DSH 插件市场控制台

在 DSH 的「**设置 → 插件**」分区里，加一个能**搜索、安装、启停、卸载**第三方插件的标签页。

- 目标客户端：`DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.1`（desktop profile）
- 一个包，两个半边：Host 半边是空的（只为占一条 Loader 行），全部逻辑在 Client 半边
- 所有真实操作都走官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager` 的 Typert 远程接口
- 本插件自身**不会**出现在被管理列表或搜索结果里

---

## 1. 目录结构

```
dsh-market-console/
├── package.json          # 声明 dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 挂载声明（自己插入自己）
└── lib/
    ├── index.js          # Host 半边：空 apply()，只为占一条 Loader 行
    └── client.js         # Client 半边：设置标签页 + 全部 UI
```

---

## 2. 安装

### 2.1 解析目标 profile（**绝不写死 `web`**）

```
profile = DSH_DESKTOP_PROFILE  →  DSH_PROFILE  →  web
```

实测：`DSH_PROFILE=desktop`，`DSH_PROFILE_DIR=%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop`。

### 2.2 一键脚本（推荐）

```powershell
pwsh -File scripts\install.ps1     # 或者直接双击 scripts\install.cmd
```

脚本按 §2.1 的规则解析 profile，幂等地做完下面三步（重复跑不会重复追加），
并在改动前把 `package.json` 与 `cordis.patch.yml` 备份成 `*.bak-<时间戳>`。

卸载：`scripts\uninstall.cmd`（支持 `-WhatIf` 预览、`-KeepPackage` 只摘挂载）。

> **两个已踩过的环境坑：**
> 1. 本机执行策略禁止直接运行 `.ps1`，所以附带的 `.cmd` 包装器带了
>    `-ExecutionPolicy Bypass`，双击即可。
> 2. 脚本文件必须存成**带 BOM 的 UTF-8** —— PowerShell 5.1 对无 BOM 的文件按 ANSI
>    解析，中文注释会直接导致语法错误。而**写出去的数据文件必须无 BOM**，
>    否则 DSH 的 `JSON.parse` 会炸。仓库里的文件两种情况都已处理对。

### 2.3 手工三步

```powershell
$DSH_HOME   = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh"
$SRC        = "<本包所在目录>"
$PROFILE    = "desktop"                       # 来自上面的解析

# ① 放进 Node 解析路径（desktop 没有自己的 node_modules，靠父层解析）
New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path "$DSH_HOME\profiles\node_modules\dsh-market-console" -Target $SRC

# ② 在 profile 的 dependencies 里登记（满足「实例只认 package.json dependencies」）
#    编辑 $DSH_HOME\profiles\$PROFILE\package.json → dependencies 加：
#      "dsh-market-console": "0.1.0"

# ③ 在 profile 的挂载文件末尾追加 insert 行
#    编辑 $DSH_HOME\profiles\$PROFILE\cordis.patch.yml → 末尾追加：
#      - insert:
#          - id: market-console
#            name: dsh-market-console
```

### 2.4 重启客户端（或者先试只刷新页面）

`cordis.patch.yml` 是启动时读的，所以**刷新页面不够**——但前提是 profile 没启用 HMR。

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-hmr` 会监听 profile manifest 和两份用户 patch；启用 HMR 时，
改完 patch 会触发**热重载**：重新组合 Loader 图，浏览器跟随更新，**不需要重启**。

本机实测（0.2.0-rc.1 / desktop）：改完 patch 后未重启，`/plugins` 路由已经能提供
本插件的 bundle，内容与源文件逐字节一致。判断办法（无需认证）：

```powershell
# rev = sha1("plugin-artifact" + "\0" + 各字段长度前缀式拼接) 取前 12 位
# 字段依次是 String(mtimeMs), String(ctimeMs), String(size)
# 命中则 HTTP 200，否则 404
```

**首次安装与卸载仍建议重启**，因为这两个动作还会改动 profile 的 `package.json`。

---

## 3. 两条必须记住的契约（踩过的坑）

### 3.1 `dsh.client.inject` 填的是**包名**，不是 cordis 服务名

`package.json` 里：

```json
"dsh": {
  "client": {
    "platform": "web",
    "inject": [
      "@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-remotes",
      "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale",
      "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules",
      "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings"
    ]
  }
}
```

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules` 的 `parseDshClient()` 只校验这是 `string[]`，但组合阶段会把每一项当作**模块图的排序边**（"让动态提供方先于其消费方加载"）。填 `"slots"` / `"locale"` 这类服务名，图里找不到对应 row。

**服务名写在另一个地方** —— Client 半边的 `exports.inject`：

```js
const inject = ['slots', 'locale', 'remote', 'remote.pluginManager', 'modules'];
```

两者同名不同义，别搞混。官方 69 个客户端包的 `dsh.client.inject` 全是包名。

### 3.2 Client 半边的组件 props 来自 `inject` 的**展开**

`ctx.slots.register({ ..., inject: injected }, Component)` 里，`injected()` 的返回值会被
**展开成组件的 props**：

```js
// 官方 ui-settings-plugin-inventory 的写法
function PluginInventorySettingsTab({ list, presetName, resolveText, t, useClientSync, retryClient }) { ... }

// 于是本插件也直接解构
function MarketConsoleTab({ t, data, resolveText, availableRegistries }) { ... }
```

**不要**写成 `function Tab(props) { const x = props.injected() }` —— 那样 `t` 是
`undefined`，`t('...')` 直接抛 TypeError，标签页白屏。

另外 `hooks: { clientSync }` 会被系统转成 `useClientSync` 这样的 **hook prop**；普通字段原样传递。

---

## 4. 功能

### 已安装视图

- 插件条目（`listPlugins`）与组合包（`listBundles`）分组展示
- 每条显示：标题、模块名、版本、描述、启用状态、fiber 阶段（等待/加载/运行中/启动失败/卸载中）
- **插件条目**：开关直接调 `setPluginEnabled(entryId, enabled)`
- **组合包**：开关调 `setBundleEnabled(name, enabled)`；卸载调 `removeBundle(name)`，**二次确认**后才执行
- 本地过滤框（名称 / 模块 / 条目 id）

### 官方标记与筛选

- **「官方」徽章** —— 标题旁边标出 DSH 自带的插件。判定规则（`isOfficialPackage`）：
  - `@deepseek-ai/*` —— DSH 自家发布的包；
  - `cordis:*` —— cordis 框架内置插件，**协议限定名**，磁盘上没有对应目录，只能按前缀认；
  - 第三方（`dsh-whale-widget`、本插件自己）不带徽章。
- **「隐藏官方」开关** —— 已安装视图工具栏里。打开后列表只剩自己装的第三方插件，
  下方给出「已隐藏 N 个官方插件」，分组计数变成 `已显示 / 总数`。
- **偏好持久化** —— 开关状态写进 `localStorage`（`dsh-market-console/prefs`），重开不用再点一次。
- **搜索视图同样带官方徽章，但不受这个开关影响** —— 发现新插件时把官方包一并藏掉没有意义。

### 插件备注

每张卡片（插件条目与组合包）底下都有一条备注行：

- **内置说明** —— **196 条**一句话中文描述，覆盖**全部 loader 条目**（脚本核过零遗漏）：
  - **客户端包**（67 个）逐条人工精简，从各包 `README.zh.md` 的 `description` frontmatter 出发，
    把「面向用户与维护者的 web GUI 客户端模块系统说明：宿主侧组合启动图并提供插件 bundle…」
    压成「客户端模块系统：扫描已启用的插件，把它们的浏览器代码组合起来送进页面。」
  - **host 侧插件**（128 个）批量提取后按规则收紧：剥掉「面向 XXX 的 YYY 说明，用于选择、配置或排查…」
    这类模板腔，只留主干。
  - **cordis 框架内置插件**（`cordis:include` / `cordis:group` / `cordis:timer` / `cordis:loader`）——
    它们是协议限定名，不对应磁盘上的包，只能手写。
  - 外加鲸鱼挂件与本插件自身。
  - 数据是代码里的 `BUILTIN_NOTES`，key 用 Loader 条目的 moduleName。
- **自己改** —— 点「编辑」写自己的备注，保存立即生效，标注为「我的备注」。
- **恢复内置** —— 改过的备注可一键恢复成内置说明。实现上是**直接删键**而不是存空值，
  这样以后内置文案改版还能重新显示出来。
- **存储** —— `localStorage` 的 `dsh-market-console/notes`，纯本机界面偏好：
  不碰插件本身、不碰 profile、不产生任何 Host 侧写入。
- **优先级** —— 用户备注 > 内置说明 > 提示添加。内置文案改版不会覆盖你写的东西。

### 发现视图（npm 搜索）

- 客户端直连 npm registry 的 `/-/v1/search`（该端点返回 `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`，无需 Host 代理）
- 关键词：`keywords:dsh-plugin <你的词>`
- registry 可切换，兜底顺序：`registry.npmjs.org` → `registry.npmmirror.com`，失败自动换下一个
- 400ms 防抖
- 已安装的包标记「已安装」，不显示安装按钮

### 安装链路（M2）

```
inspect(spec)  →  人话化 problem  →  installBundle(spec, { requestId, registry, approvedBuilds })
                →  waitForInstall(requestId)  →  application 处理
```

- `refused` 的 7 种 `problem` 全部映射成中文人话
- `restart-required` 会**显式提示重启**（并说明刷新页面无效）
- 构建脚本待批准（`packageResult.pendingBuilds`）→ 列出准确包名 → 用户确认 → 带 `approvedBuilds` 重试
- 安装中可 `cancelInstall(requestId)`
- 版本门控拒绝时列出不兼容的依赖

### 写操作错误码（12 种）

`management-required` · `unaddressable` · `unknown-plugin` · `invalid-spec` · `ambiguous-install` ·
`not-bundle` · `not-removable` · `stop-profile` · `bundle-in-use` · `stale-approval` ·
`incompatible-version` · `operation-error` —— 全部有中文映射。

---

## 5. 自身排除（C4）

`SELF_PACKAGE = 'dsh-market-console'`，并且下列模块在列表和搜索里都标记为**只读**：

| 类别 | 模块 |
|---|---|
| 自身 | `dsh-market-console` |
| 其他市场 | `dsh-unified-market` · `dsh-plugin-shop` |
| 插件管理基础设施 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager` · `dsh-host-plugin-inventory` · `dsh-client-ui-plugin-manager` · `dsh-client-ui-settings-plugin` · `dsh-api-remotes` · `dsh-client-modules` |
| DSH 运行底座 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` · `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` · `@deepseek-ai/cordis` |

只读项的开关与卸载按钮是禁用的。判定用**段边界匹配**，所以 `dsh-baseball` 不会被误判成 `dsh-base`。

---

## 6. 故障排查

### 界面里没有「插件市场」标签页

按顺序查：

1. **挂载行在不在**

   ```powershell
   Select-String -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\cordis.patch.yml" -Pattern "market-console"
   ```

   没有 → 补上 §2.2 的第 ③ 步。DSH 大版本更新时可能重写这个文件（鲸鱼插件中过这招）。

2. **包在不在 Node 解析路径上**

   ```powershell
   Test-Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\node_modules\dsh-market-console\lib\client.js"
   ```

3. **重启了没有** —— `cordis.patch.yml` 只在启动时读取。

4. **看 Host 启动日志**里有没有 `client-modules: ... failed to compose` 或
   `client bundle not found` / `declares dsh.client but exports no "./client" bundle`。

### 标签页出现了但一片空白

多半是 Client 半边抛异常。在 DSH 窗口按 `Ctrl+Shift+I` 打开开发者工具看 Console。
最常见的是 §3.2 的 props 契约问题。

### 装完没反应

`application: 'restart-required'` —— 需要重启客户端。UI 里会明确提示。

### 搜索搜不到东西

registry 不可达。UI 里换 registry，或检查该 registry 是否支持 `/-/v1/search` 端点。

---

## 7. 卸载

1. 从 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 删掉那个 `insert` 块
2. 从 profile 的 `package.json` 的 `dependencies` 删掉 `dsh-market-console`
3. 删掉 `profiles/node_modules/dsh-market-console` 链接
4. 重启客户端

---

## 8. 自检与诊断

`scripts/diagnose.cjs` 一条命令走完「静态安装 → host 运行实例」全链路，逐项给结论和修复建议：

```powershell
node scripts\diagnose.cjs              # 全量
node scripts\diagnose.cjs --offline    # 只做不依赖运行实例的检查
node scripts\diagnose.cjs --url http://127.0.0.1:19387
```

它检查四组内容：

1. **C1 / C3** — profile 按 `DSH_DESKTOP_PROFILE → DSH_PROFILE → DSH_PROFILE_DIR → web` 解析，包在 Node 解析路径上
2. **包清单** — `package.json` 可解析、`dsh.client

plugins.description: A multi-agent group chat for DSH that decides who is worth waking: durable message log, attention routing, and cross-workspace membership.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-attention-group

**A multi-agent group chat for DSH that decides who is worth waking.**

A durable room for several DSH sessions — plus your own — where a message is written down
first, routed second, and only then allowed to wake anyone. An irrelevant message costs
**zero turns**.

---

## Why this is not another group chat

Every group chat spends its budget at delivery time: it wakes everyone, and each woken
member then discovers the message was not for them. That is N turns for one message nobody
needed.

This plugin moves the decision *before* the wake. Posting a message returns a routing plan

```
routing: SILENT — nobody matched, zero turns spent
```

or

```
routing: 1 recipient(s) — plan only, nothing woken
  room-admin	mention	not-woken (dry run)
```

Waking is a second, explicit step, and it needs **two** switches to agree (see
[Two switches](#waking-is-two-switches)).

Three consequences that are design rules here, not accidents:

- **Creating a room, adding members, reading history, exporting and summarising never wake anybody.**
- **A panel message that names nobody wakes nobody** — only NAMING somebody (`@name`, or `@所有人`
  while the room has 「允许 @所有人」 on) **and** the room's 「唤醒」 switch being on makes the panel
  wake those people. Beyond that, the only panel action that starts a turn is 「生成群史摘要」 (also
  gated on 「唤醒」 — see [Room-history summaries](#room-history-summaries-r9)). No name, no event:
  a person typing in their own panel is not a reason to run somebody else's session.
- **Nothing calls another plugin.** Rooms, transcripts, conclusions and exports are plain
  files, so this works on a bare DSH and survives this plugin being uninstalled.

---

## Quick start

### What you need

- DSH **0.2.1-rc.2** (this is the version every interface here was last verified against; it was
  first built against 0.2.0-rc.2, re-verified on 0.2.1-rc.1, and re-checked on 0.2.1-rc.2).
- A profile to install into. The examples below use `--profile desktop`.

### Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:cilarx/dsh-attention-group
```

That is the whole install. It was **verified end to end from a clean profile** on 2026-10-17:
the command exits 0, DSH initializes the profile, and the package lands with all seven
source files, its bundle patch and its `cordis.patch.yml`.

The bare-name form `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-attention-group` does **not** resolve
yet, because there is no npm release. Use the `github:` form above.

Any of a directory path, a tarball, or a git URL works, because `dsh plugin` **is** package
management: it delegates to `pnpm` in the profile directory (run `dsh plugin --profile <name>`
with no subcommand and pnpm's own help comes back). What makes the package a *plugin* is that
`package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch`.

A fresh profile gets **both halves** of the contract written for it automatically — the
dependency *and* the bundle layer — which is what makes the plugin actually load rather than
merely be installed:

```json
{ "dependencies": { "dsh-attention-group": "github:cilarx/dsh-attention-group" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "dsh-attention-group"] } } }
```

### Offline / from a checkout

Installing by path works too, and a packed tarball is verified end to end:

```bash
npm pack --pack-destination /tmp
dsh plugin --profile some-fresh-name add /tmp/dsh-attention-group-0.1.0.tgz
# → dsh: initialized profile some-fresh-name at ~/.dsh/profiles/some-fresh-name
```

Afterwards the new profile's `package.json` contained **both** halves of the contract on its
own — the dependency *and* the bundle layer:

```json
{ "dependencies": { "dsh-attention-group": "file:...tgz" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "dsh-attention-group"] } } }
```

and importing the installed copy from inside that profile succeeded, resolving
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` from the shared `~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules`. So **a brand-new
profile can load this plugin** — that is what "works on a bare DSH" means here.

**A `link:` dependency and a directory junction both fail** (`unverified` for your machine,
measured here on 2026-10-16). Node resolves imports from a module's *real* path, so a linked
copy outside the profile resolves `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` outside the profile too:

```
attention-group (dsh-attention-group): failed to import
ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools'
```

Installing a real copy inside the profile is what fixes it.

### Verify the install registered

Two places in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json` must name the package — a package
that is only in `dependencies` is installed but **is not a profile layer**, and nothing will
happen:

```json
{
  "dependencies": { "dsh-attention-group": "..." },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ "...", "dsh-attention-group" ] } }
}
```

### Restart DSH — this step is not optional

Host-side code (`src/index.js` and friends) is loaded once, at startup. Toggling the plugin
in the plugin panel does **not** re-import it; measured here, a newly added tool stayed
`unknown tool` across a toggle and appeared only after a restart. Install, then restart, then
look for the 「群聊」 entry in the sidebar.

### Development loop (source tree → live profile)

Because of the real-path rule above, editing this checkout edits nothing that DSH loads.
`tools/sync-plugin.ps1` copies the package into the profile and then *imports the copy* to
prove it still loads:

```powershell
pwsh -File tools/sync-plugin.ps1
```

### First 60 seconds

1. Sidebar → 「群聊」 → 「＋」 → name the room.
2. Settings → turn 「唤醒」 on only when you actually want group messages to be able to start
   turns.
3. Settings → add a member: **click the id box** and a list of this machine's sessions appears
   (title, workspace, last activity, most recent first) — click one and both the id and the
   `@` name are filled in. Pasting an id (`session-<uuid>` **or** a bare `<uuid>`) still works,
   and any stable id with kind `user` / `admin` / `bot` / `liaison` makes it a name in the room.
4. Ask the agent in that session to call `attention_group_list`, then `attention_send` with
   `wake` left off — you get the plan, and nobody is disturbed.

### Confirm the runtime is healthy

Call the `attention_probe` tool. It reports the data root, how many rooms exist, which live
agents are visible, which optional services this deployment offers, the last five wake-up
attempts with the path each one took, the status of the panel route (`registered`, or the
exact reason it is not), and whether the unread prompt line registered (`promptContext` — a
deployment with no prompt service loses that nudge, and this says so). A missing panel that
reads as "you have no rooms" is the failure this line exists to prevent.

---

## Core concepts

### Room

A room is a record in a JSON ledger plus one append-only JSONL transcript. It has an id
derived from its title (`插件工程协调-fpab`), a title, a charter, a member list, a routing
mode, one group-wide reasoning-effort knob, four sink settings, and a list of outgoing
liaisons.

### Member kinds

| kind | What it is | Can it be woken? |
|---|---|---|
| `session` | A DSH session, identified by its session id. | Yes — live or cold-resumed. |
| `user` | The human. The panel acts as this member. | No — recorded only. |
| `admin` | The room's built-in administrator. «总结今天»-style requests default to the first enabled `admin`. | No — recorded only, unless it is also a session id. |
| `bot` | Any non-session automated participant. | No — recorded only. |
| `liaison` | A reserved kind for an inter-room courier (see [Liaisons](#liaisons-r10)). | No — recorded only. |

**Both session-id shapes are real**: `session-<uuid>` and a bare `<uuid>`. Measured 2026-10-16
against the live runtime, `008bda70-4811-4349-a1a5-d6c6ff54d7d1` is a stored, resumable session
with a resolvable route — and most sessions on the machine this was developed on look like that.
An earlier version of this plugin required the `session-` prefix, which quietly made roughly
seventy real sessions unwakeable; the guard now accepts both.

Only ids that loo

plugins.description: Progressive tool discovery for DeepSeek Harness PTC using the official scoped registry
plugins.readme_text: # PTC Tool Search English | [中文](README.zh.md) Load PTC tool definitions on demand while preserving conversation history. Across 12 live four-turn sessions, the plugin reduced mean cumulative conversation input by **51.46% (GPT)** and **50.00% (Muse)**. Output tokens and latency are reported alongside the reductions. An independent community Host bundle using the official DeepSeek Harness scoped tool registry. Version 0.1.1 supports **Harness 0.2.1-rc.2** and Node.js 24+. ## Repeated live results Measured on 2026-10-18: macOS ARM64, Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2, CLIProxyAPI Responses. **3 runs per model per group: 12 new sessions, 48 turns and 12 real image generations.** Identical four-turn prompts cover JSON reading, terminal execution, result writing, tool-free recall, image generation and file readback. A uses the full PTC SDK; B enables this plugin. Values below are means per complete four-turn session. | Model | Input tokens A → B | Input reduction | Output tokens A → B | Active seconds A → B | Workflow completion A / B | | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | | GPT 6.1 Sol | 153,825.0 → 74,669.7 | **51.46%** | 814.3 → 1,161.0 | 48.01 → 64.44 | 3/3 · 3/3 | | Muse Spark 1.3 | 193,155.3 → 96,569.0 | **50.00%** | 4,173.3 → 3,728.0 | 45.93 → 43.10 | 3/3 · 3/3 | Uncached input increased: GPT 6.1 Sol: 23,521.0 → 31,405.7 (+33.52%); Muse Spark 1.3: 25,761.0 → 31,464.0 (+22.14%). These results do not establish billing savings. Input includes cache reads/writes, searches and retries. Output counts conversation-model tokens; the image service does not expose its own token usage. Active time includes tools and image generation, excluding gaps between user prompts. **Actual charges: not reported**, never treated as zero; no billing reduction is claimed. The initial SDK shrank from **35 definitions to 2**; mean first-request input fell **80.27–80.79%**. Both groups expose only `run_code` at the API level. Discovery adds round trips: mean model requests were GPT 6.1 Sol: 7.0 → 11.7; Muse Spark 1.3: 8.0 → 12.0. Output and latency need not decrease, and the SDK grows as tools accumulate. GPT had no tool errors; Muse A/B had 4/3 recoverable errors respectively, all retried to completion and included. **Image dimensions:** every call requested `1024x1024`, returned GPT 6.1 Sol: 1254×1254 (n=6); Muse Spark 1.3: 1536×1024 (n=6); exact size matches: **0/12**. Workflow success covers tool execution, arithmetic, recall and image artifacts, not requested-size compliance. Compare A/B within each model, not image speed across models. This is a small repeated sample of one fixed workflow. See the [per-run report, method and limitations](docs/benchmark-2026-10-18.md) and [auditable data](docs/benchmark-2026-10-18.json) for means, medians and ranges. ## Install Use Harness **Plugins → Add plugin**, then enter `github:hrygo/dsh-ptc-tool-search#v0.1.1`, or use the official CLI: ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:hrygo/dsh-ptc-tool-search#v0.1.1 ``` For an immutable installation, replace `v0.1.1` with the full commit SHA in the [release notes](https://github.com/hrygo/dsh-ptc-tool-search/releases/tag/v0.1.1). The release also provides a tarball and SHA-256 checksum. Download and verify them, then install with `dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./hrygo-dsh-ptc-tool-search-0.1.1.tgz`. This package ships executable ESM JavaScript: no compilation, dependencies, `prepare` script or build-script permission is needed. Restart Desktop after replacing an installed version, then create a PTC session. Remove a previous local development installation first; only one `tool_search` plugin may be enabled. Distribution follows the official [package and install guide](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/en/develop/basic/publish). This package is not currently published to npm. ## Use New PTC agents initially see `tools.tool_search` plus agent-owned tools. Inside `run_code`: ```js return await tools.tool_search({ query: 'bash', limit: 1 }); ``` End that `run_code`. On the next model request Harness regenerates the SDK with the selected tool; call `tools.bash` in another `run_code`. Print or return the search result once. Prefer exact callable names and `limit:1`; short English capability keywords also work. Search uses deterministic lexical matching, without network calls or embeddings. Selections accumulate for each live agent. Recreated agents, including after restart or resume, discover again. Existing live agents at installation retain their previous surface. Tools registered after agent creation need a new agent to enter its catalog. Standard/native mode is unaffected. Other policy restrictions remain enforced; discovery cannot grant an excluded capability. ## Configuration and rollback The bundle inserts row `ptc-tool-search`. Configure it through Harness plugin configuration: | Key | Default | Meaning | | --- | --- | --- | | `enabled` | `true` | Enable discovery for new PTC agents. | | `maxResults` | `3` | Maximum results accepted by a search call; positive integer. | | `maxQueryChars` | `256` | Maximum query length; positive integer. | | `maxDescriptionChars` | `160` | Search result description length; positive integer. | The selected SDK retains full tool definitions. Search adds a model round trip; broad queries can load unnecessary definitions. As tools are selected, the SDK grows. Disable or uninstall **PTC Tool Search** in Plugin Manager and create a new PTC session to restore full SDK visibility. No app or proxy changes are required. ## Verification ```sh npm test npm run check npm pack --dry-run ``` Nine tests cover ranking, bounds, scope isolation, policy intersection, unload and recreation. Local macOS ARM64 acceptance on 2026-10-18 verified GPT 6.1 Sol and Muse Spark 1.3 over CLIProxyAPI Responses, including terminal calls, follow-up memory and image generation. See [acceptance details](docs/validation.md), including image attachment and file checks. No runtime dependencies, credential handling, install scripts, prompt rewriting or custom persistent session events are added. Harness owns SDK generation, guarded tool dispatch, approvals and logging. ## License [MIT](LICENSE).

plugins.description: Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead of your settings.yaml.
plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

plugins.description: A quieter way to keep moving. State-aware next-instruction drafts for DeepSeek DSH. 下一步，自然发生。
plugins.readme_text:
English · 简体中文

![Next instruction suggestions. A quieter way to keep moving.](docs/readme/cover.png)

Download · Get started · Under the hood · MIT license

# Next instruction suggestions **The next step, without breaking your flow.** A small, considered plugin for **DeepSeek DSH**. When an assistant finishes a turn, it offers up to three concrete next instructions above the composer. Choose one, refine it, and send it when you are ready. Suggestions are optional. **A click fills your draft; it never sends a message or runs an action.** --- ### Less friction. More intention. | A little help | A clear boundary | | :--- | :--- | | **Relevant next steps** | Uses recent conversation text, open todos, tool outcomes, changed files, and the assistant's open question to propose short, concrete instructions. | | **Your words, your decision** | One click fills the composer and returns focus. Edit before sending. | | **Quiet by design** | Hides as you type, open the command menu, change sessions, or press Escape in the composer. Results arriving after 1.5 seconds are discarded. | | **A lighter model preference** | Auto mode favors names such as `flash`, `mini`, and `lite`. This is a naming heuristic, not a live price comparison. | | **Small, explicit context** | Sends limited text and tool names/targets—not tool outputs—to a provider configured in DSH, with common secret patterns and path usernames redacted. | ![Illustrative suggestion dock and composer with example content.](docs/readme/preview.png)

Illustrative interface with example content. Actual appearance follows your DSH theme.

### A simple rhythm 1. **Finish a turn.** Leave the composer empty after the assistant responds. 2. **Choose a direction.** Pick a suggestion, or dismiss it with `×`. 3. **Make it yours.** Review the draft, edit freely, and send it yourself. The plugin waits for at least two user turns. Thin context or greetings may produce no suggestions. Dismissed suggestions are filtered in page memory, capped at 20 entries per session across 50 tracked browser sessions. ### Why the next step is concrete The host keeps a compact state packet for the completed turn: recent tool calls and results (name, target, success/failure), changed files, running or recent jobs, active goal/plan, open todos, and the assistant's open question. It does not separately load full tool outputs, attachment bodies, or file contents into the prompt. The model is asked for up to five candidates. A local ranker then selects at most three by grounding (a file, test, command, or function named in the state), fit to the assistant's question, a state prior (for example, favor commit after a completed run with changes; favor fixes after a failed action), and intent diversity (change / verify / inspect / ship). This can make suggestions shorter and more specific than a generic "continue". ## Getting started **Requirements:** Node.js **22.19 or later**, DeepSeek DSH **`>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`**, a Web GUI or Desktop client, and a configured model provider. The original development baseline was DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`; the full range has not been tested against every release. ### Install the release package 1. Open the [latest release](https://github.com/Jul11us/dsh-next-suggestion/releases/latest) and copy the `.tgz` asset URL. 2. In DSH, open **Plugins → Add plugin / Install third-party plugin** and enter the `.tgz` download URL in the package field. 3. Enable **Next instruction suggestions**, restart DSH, then refresh the client. If your installer does not accept an archive URL, extract the archive and install the inner `package` directory as a local plugin. ### Install from source ```sh git clone https://github.com/Jul11us/dsh-next-suggestion.git cd dsh-next-suggestion npm ci --ignore-scripts ``` Add the cloned directory through DSH's local plugin installer, enable the bundle, restart DSH, and refresh the client. A desktop-profile CLI alternative is: ```text dsh plugin --profile desktop add "file:C:\path\to\dsh-next-suggestion" ``` This version is distributed through GitHub Release. These installation methods do not require an npm registry publication. ## Tune the experience Open **Plugins → Next instruction suggestions → Configure**, or **Settings → Next suggestions**. | Setting | Default | Purpose | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | Enable predictions | On | Turning this off stops new prediction calls. | | Candidates | `3` | Show between one and three suggestions. | | Provider / model | Empty | Auto-select a route, or specify your preferred provider and model. | | Host timeout | `8000 ms` | Bound the host request; the interface still has a 1.5-second display window. | | Debug details | Off | Show token counts, latency, and call count. | Automatic routing prefers models with lightweight names. When it falls back to a reasoning or expensive-looking model, it allows at most one prediction per tracked session. A provider-only setting stays within that provider; a model-only setting resolves that exact model. Choosing both overrides automatic routing. Prediction calls can consume provider credits. ## Context, with limits The plugin may send the session title, up to six open todos, up to six recent user/assistant turns, and a compact state packet (tool names and targets, success/failure, changed file paths, job labels, active goal/plan, and the assistant's open question) to your configured provider. It does **not separately load** tool output bodies, attachment bodies, or file contents into the prompt. Assistant prose is shortened and fenced code blocks are replaced with `[code]`. User messages, shell command text, goals, or todo labels can still contain pasted code or sensitive material. Common API-key/token patterns, bearer strings, long base64 content, and usernames in common home-directory paths are redacted before the request. **Redaction is best effort; it cannot recognize every secret or personal detail.** Review the provider you select and the conversation you use it with. The plugin does not separately read file contents, attachment bodies, or tool-output bodies into its prompt. It adds no analytics endpoint and does not write prediction context to disk. In-memory state is cleared on reload or host restart as appropriate; DSH and your provider have their own storage behavior. ## Built to be understood Two small JavaScript modules, public DSH extension points, and no build step. The host tracks turns and prepares model calls; the client renders suggestions and edits the draft. No core patches are required. - [Architecture and extension points](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) - [Publishing guide](PUBLISHING.md) - [Host tests](https://github.com/Jul11us/dsh-next-suggestion/blob/main/test/host.test.mjs) · [Client tests](https://github.com/Jul11us/dsh-next-suggestion/blob/main/test/client.test.mjs) ```sh npm ci --ignore-scripts npm test npm pack --dry-run # inspect the prompt of a replay case without spending tokens node scripts/eval-replay.mjs --dry-run ``` The commands above run from a source checkout. Optional replay evaluation with your own provider (PowerShell): ```powershell # score top-1/top-3 against the message that actually followed a turn node scripts/export-golden.mjs "C:\path\to\session.v4.jsonl.zstd" scripts/golden/session.json $env:EVAL_BASE_URL="https://api.deepseek.com" $env:EVAL_API_KEY="..." $env:EVAL_MODEL="deepseek-chat" node scripts/eval-replay.mjs --cases scripts/golden/session.json ``` `npm test` covers 28 host checks and 8 client checks, including the state packet, grounding/diversity ranking, open-question code filtering, job-failure ordering, timeout, cancellation, and the actual host response rendered by the client. The replay harness uses the shipped prompt, parser, and ranker; keep exported session cases out of git (they contain private conversation text). These checks do not certif

plugins.description: 用于在 DeepSeek 会话中显示 Git 面板：分支、ahead/behind、改动清单与差异，「这个会话改过哪些文件、审到哪了、跑了什么工具」，运行了多长时间等内容。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-hud > 一个只读的工作区 Git 面板：分支、ahead/behind、改动清单与差异，外加「这个会话改过哪些文件、审到哪了、跑了什么工具」。 > A read-only workspace Git panel for DeepSeek Harness, with per-session change attribution. ![输入框上方的三枚胶囊：左边是 Git 状态，中间是工具与技能，最右边是本次会话运行时长](docs/images/capsules.webp) *左：工作区名 · `git:(分支*)` · ahead/behind · 改动计数 · 本会话改过几个文件。右：每个工具的调用次数、正在跑什么、以及会话调用过哪些技能 —— 图中 `aihot ×1` 是红的，因为那次调用失败了。* ## 安装 桌面端「设置 → 插件 → 添加插件」里填 `@konnga/dsh-hud`。 本地开发时把 profile 的依赖指向仓库（改动即时可见；客户端代码要重启应用才重读）： ```json "@konnga/dsh-hud": "link:/path/to/dsh-hud" ``` ## 你会看到什么 ### 胶囊（输入框上方） ``` dsh-hud · git:(main*) ↑1 ↓2 M4 A1 ?1 │ ●3 ``` - `dsh-hud` —— 工作区名（当前会话的目录名）。太长从中间省略，完整路径看悬停。 - `git:(main*)` —— 分支。`*` 表示工作区不干净；detached 时是 `git:(detached abc1234)`。 - `↑1 ↓2` —— 与上游的领先 / 落后（为 0 不显示）。 - `M4 A1 ?1` —— 改动计数，只列非零项：`M` 修改 · `A` 新增 · `D` 删除 · `R` 重命名 · `C` 复制 · `T` 类型改变 · `?` 未跟踪 · `!` 冲突。 - `●3` —— 本会话改过 3 个文件（没有就不显示）。 点它开面板；悬停给出完整路径、上游与各类计数。**不在 git 仓库里也会显示**（只有工作区名 + `git:(非 git 仓库)`）。 ### 工具胶囊（同一行的中间，只在跑过工具后出现） ``` ◐ bash: pnpm test 1.2s ← 正在跑（秒数实时跳） ✓ bash ×16 │ ✓ apply_patch ×6 │ skills: office-xlsx ×2 +2 ← 空闲 ``` - 每个工具一个计数；前面的 `✓` / `✗` 是**它自己最近一次调用**的结果。 - `skills:` 后面是会话调用过的**技能名**（不是"技能调了几次"—— 看得出是哪一个）。 - 最多铺 3 个工具、2 个技能，其余收成 `+k`；悬停里有完整清单与最近几条的执行结果。 ### 会话计时胶囊（同一行的最右边，单独一枚） ``` ⏱ 2h 14m ``` **本次会话已经运行了多久** —— 口径与 [codex-hud](https://github.com/konnga/codex-hud) 的会话时长完全一致：**挂钟时间 = 现在 − 会话创建时刻**（含等待与空闲），格式也是同一套（`<1m` / `45m` / `2h 14m` / `3d 2h`，不足一分钟写 `<1m`，只列非零项）。 悬停补齐"这段时间里真正在干什么"： ``` 本次会话运行时长 · 创建于 2026-10-14 17:58 · 其中模型 1h 29m、工具 23m · 27 轮 / 380 步 ``` - 模型 / 工具墙钟与轮次、步数来自内置 **`sessionStats` 投影**（它从完整持久日志折叠，分页与压实都不会让数字跳变）；那个投影没注册（插件被组合掉 / 旧宿主）时**只显示挂钟时长**，不编造后两项。 - 数字一分钟取一次（宿主侧同样带 60 秒缓存），显示每 4 秒自跳一次 —— 跨分钟不用等下一次请求。 - **刚重启的头几秒可能还没有它**：会话是异步恢复到宿主存储里的（实测启动 0.6 秒时存储里是空的、约 30 秒后才进去），所以取数失败时用 **3 秒**的节奏重问（拿到之后才换成 60 秒），而不是把"还没有"缓存一分钟。 - 会话不在（还没恢复进宿主的会话存储、已归档、子会话已回收）或宿主没有 `sessions` 服务时，**整枚不渲染**，不留空壳。 - 它与 Git / 工具两枚由**同一条 dock 注册**画出来、排在**最后** —— dock 是竖列，独立注册会另起一整行（工具胶囊当年踩过一次，计时胶囊又踩了一次：位置就是这么错的）。 - 只读读数，指针不是"可点"；数字用等宽数字，跳动时宽度不抖。 ### 面板（点胶囊打开） ![面板：左边是改动概览与本会话改了哪些、改动清单、最近提交、标签；中间是这次提交的明细；右边是差异](docs/images/panel.webp) *上图是「看某次提交」时的样子：左边是面板本身，中间是这次提交改了哪个文件，右边是差异。标题栏可拖动，`⟳` 刷新 · `⌖` 复位位置 · `✕` 收起。* 1. **仓库路径 · 上游 · 短 oid** 2. **改动概览** —— 按类型分组的彩色计数；干净时写「工作区干净」。 3. **本会话改了哪些** —— 一行计数（`本会话改过 3 个文件 · 另有 2 个可能相关 · 1 个已不在 git 现状里`）加开关：`只看本会话改的`、`只看最近一轮`（拿得到回合信息时才出现）；有已审标记时还有 `已审 3/8` 与 `清空已审`。 4. **改动清单** —— 每行 `标记 状态字母 路径`，重命名读作 `旧 → 新`。 - 行首：`●` 确定改过 · `◐` 可能相关（从命令里看出来的，悬停给出那条命令）· `○` 与本会话无关。 - 行尾：`○` / `✓` 是审阅标记 —— 点一下或按 `v` 切换；`✓` 变黄表示改动又变了，需要重看。 - 点任意一行看这个文件的差异。 5. **最近提交** —— `短sha 标题 [HEAD] 2026-10-16 14:18`；点一行看这次提交，再点一次收起。 6. **标签** —— `tag 名 短sha [HEAD] 时间`，新的在前；点一行看它指向的提交。仓库没有标签时会写一行「这个仓库还没有标签」。 时间一律是**完整年月日 + 时分**（本地时区），提交与标签两处一样。 ### 差异与提交明细 - **看差异**：两栏 —— 左边还是面板，右边是差异。工具栏有 `未暂存` / `已暂存` 页签、`自动换行`、`复制差异`。点 hunk 头可折叠那一段。 - **看提交**：三栏 —— 面板 │ 这次提交 │ 差异，并自动打开这次提交的第一个文件。`Esc` 或 `✕` 收起。 - **两条抓握可以拖**：右边缘那条调差异栏宽度（默认 470px）；提交明细栏右边那条调提交明细栏（默认 240px）—— 路径被截断就往左拖。两条宽度都会记住。 - **看图片改动**：二进制文件里认得出是图片时（PNG / JPEG / GIF / WebP / BMP，**按文件头认，不看扩展名**），差异栏画成两张图并排 —— 也可以切成单张来回看 —— 并给出尺寸变化与字节变化（`1024×768 → 1024×512`、`2.0 KB → 1.0 KB`）。两侧各自说明"为什么画不出来"：超过单侧 4 MB 预览上限、不是可预览的图片、或缺这一侧（新增 / 删除）。未暂存看「索引 → 工作区」，已暂存看「HEAD → 索引」，提交明细看「父提交 → 这次提交」—— 与文本 diff 的页签语义完全一致。 - **图片缩放**：工具条上是常显的 `−` / 档位 / `＋`：默认「适应宽度」，档位走 25% / 50% / 100% / 150% / 200%（200% 封顶），点档位本身回到「适应宽度」。固定档位按**图片固有像素**算宽度（宽高由宿主一并给出，第一帧就算对，不用等图片加载），超出部分由差异栏横向滚动。档位**会记住**（与「自动换行」一样落盘）。
内置的右侧文档预览也有缩放，但它的控件是**藏在"预览区底部 72px 的悬停感应带"里的浮层**（CSS 默认 `opacity:0`，指针离开 420ms 收起），滚轮缩放还必须按 Ctrl/⌘ —— 看不见按钮是正常的；这一排按钮就是为了不依赖它。 ![差异栏里的图片改动：工具栏是未暂存/已暂存/自动换行/复制差异，下面是「并排」与 − 100% ＋ 缩放按钮，橙色高亮写着「尺寸 190×140 → 230×160」和「8.8 KB → 11.4 KB」，两张图左右并排，左标「索引」右标「工作区」](docs/images/image-diff.webp) *上图：定了 100% 档位的两张图（左＝索引里的旧版，右＝工作区的新版），尺寸与字节的变化在标题行上一眼可见。* ### 轮尾的「本轮图片改动」（在内置改动卡片旁边） 内置那张「已编辑 N 个文件」的卡片，点一行是打开本轮的 review tab —— 图片在那里看不见（内置正文对二进制只给一句文案，而且没有给插件留正文槽位）。所以本插件在同一处轮尾放了一条自己的门： ![轮尾的「本轮图片改动」：三张缩略图，命令行旁听来的两张带 ◐ 标记，每张后面跟着一个 ⇄，末尾写「还有 3 个」](docs/images/turn-images.webp) - **点缩略图 → 在右侧内置文档预览里打开这张图**（图片原生渲染、可缩放）； - 右边那个 `⇄` → 打开本插件的面板，看这张图的**前后对比**（内置预览只有当前这一版）； - 只列**这一轮**改过的图片（按会话归因里的回合号收窄），最近改的在前，最多 4 张 + `还有 N 个`；这一轮没动过图片时整条不渲染； - 归因**两档都收**：写文件/编辑工具改的算确定（不标符号），从 shell 命令里认出来的标 `◐`、悬停给出那条命令 —— 图基本是脚本产出的（`python gen.py`、`cp`、`curl -o`），只收确定档等于收不到东西。 ### 侧栏会话行（悬停或点行尾 `⋯`） 侧栏那一行本身没有标记；信息在按需展开处，都是文字： ``` main* ↑0 ↓0 · 已修改 7 未跟踪 2 本会话改过 3 个文件 · 命令旁听到 4 个可能改动的路径（1 个现在有差异） ``` 干净时写明「工作区干净」「本会话没有改动记录」。 ## 键盘 **先在面板里点一下**（或 Tab 进去）才接管按键；点到面板外就交还。Cmd/Ctrl/Alt 组合键与输入框里的按键一律不碰。 | 键 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `↑` `↓` | 上下移动选中行（只移动，不打开） | | `Enter` | 打开选中的那条 | | `[` `]` | 上一个 / 下一个文件，并直接打开 | | `n` `p` | 下一个 / 上一个 hunk（折叠着的会展开） | | `Space` | 折叠 / 展开当前 hunk | | `v` | 把当前行标成「这一版我审过了」（再按取消） | | `r` | 重新读取 | | `Esc` | 退一层：先收右栏（差异 / 提交明细），再按才收面板 | 看提交明细时，`↑ ↓ Enter [ ]` 作用于明细那一栏的清单。 ## 它不做什么 - **只读**：不写 index、不动工作区与 git 配置，不执行 `add` / `commit` / `checkout` / `fetch`；不显示凭证。**读文件内容只有一种情形**：看图片改动时读那两侧的字节 —— 只读、只在内存里、走数据 URL 画出来，不落盘、不外链。 - **归因是两档估计**：经写文件 / 编辑工具的算「确定改过」；从 shell 命令里认出来的算「可能相关」（`>` `>>` `tee`、`sed -i` / `perl -i`、`mv` / `cp` / `rm` / `touch` / `dd of=`、`git checkout|restore <路径>`）。**会漏也会多报**，所以永远标 `◐`，不冒充 `●`；其余命令只记进命令历史，不猜路径。 - **记录不落盘**：会话改动与工具活动都活在宿主进程里，重启归零；每个会话会写明「自 … 起记录」。 - **上限**：改动清单 200 条、单会话归因 500 个文件、标签 100 个、最近提交 10 条 —— 超出只计数并标 `truncated`。 - **图片预览的边界**：只认 PNG / JPEG / GIF / WebP / BMP（按文件头，不认 SVG）；单侧超过 4 MB 只报大小不画图；**只在本插件的差异栏里生效** —— DSH 自带的改动对比页（内置 `deliverables` 的 `changes-review` 页签）没有给"文件正文"留槽位，插件改不了那一页。 - **审阅签名用 `size + mtimeMs`**：`touch` 一下（内容没变）也会让「已审」失效 —— 宁可让你多看一眼。 - **计数按文件算**：未跟踪不折叠目录（与编辑器一致）；同一个文件「既暂存又改动」算 1 条。 ## 存在浏览器里的东西 | 键 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | `dsh-hud.ui.v1` | 面板展开状态、拖动位置、两条拖出来的宽度、开关 | | `dsh-hud.reviewed.v1` | 「已审」标记（按工作区 + 文件记签名，最多 200 条） | | `dsh-hud.debug` | 最近 24 行自诊断 —— 排查「界面没反应」用，可随手删 | ## 开发 - `lib/index.js`：宿主半（跑 git、提供 `/dsh-hud-rpc`）。 - `lib/client.js`：浏览器半（**无构建步骤**，手写 JS，只依赖种子模块 `react`）。 - `npm test`：全部用例（`node --test test/*.test.mjs`）。 - `docs/dock-slot-host.md`：把输入框上方那一行做成「可注册行内宿主」的提案，给上游看的。 - **发版**：`npm run tag && npm publish`。`prepublishOnly` 先跑测试，再校验「版本号 ↔ git tag」（工作区要干净、`v<版本>` 要存在且指向 HEAD），对不上就发不出去。 ## 许可 MIT

plugins.description: Android companion for DeepSeek Harness | chat, goals, approvals & notifications from your phone, over your LAN. Kotlin + Jetpack Compose.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Mobile — DeepSeek Harness Remote

An open-source Android companion that puts your DeepSeek Harness in your pocket.
Drive sessions, review plans and goals, answer approvals and questions, and get notified when the harness finishes — from your phone, over your network or a relay.

English · 中文 · हिन्दी · Español · Français · ไทย

DSH Mobile is an **unofficial companion app** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (MIT). It mirrors the web GUI feature for feature and uses the harness's own visual language. Android only, Kotlin + Jetpack Compose. Its companion on the other end is [**dsh-relay**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-relay), a harness plugin that adds the authentication layer the harness says it lacks, so this app can reach a harness with a real credential and a pinned key instead of an open port. See [Relay](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Relay). **[dshm.zyphite.com](https://dshm.zyphite.com)** is the project site: what the app is, what it looks like, and how to get it running, on one page. The [**wiki**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki) is the user-facing guide: [getting started](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Getting-Started), [connecting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Connecting), [troubleshooting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Troubleshooting), a [feature tour](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Feature-Tour) and an [FAQ](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/FAQ). --- ## Screenshots | Connect | Chat | Trajectory | |:--:|:--:|:--:| | | | | | Recent harnesses with live reachability, LAN discovery, manual `host:port`, auto-connect. | Streamed turns, a glyph per tool, expandable tool cards, permission picker. | The same session as a per-turn ledger with usage totals. | | Session details | Subagents | |:--:|:--:| | | | | Context breakdown, goal, plan mode, background jobs, queued turns, host info, session-log export. | The subagent catalog — open a child's transcript, follow up, or interrupt it. | ## Features - Connecting — finds a harness on your Wi-Fi with an active subnet scan and a readiness handshake, remembers hosts and probes them for liveness on the way in, takes a manual `host:port`, handles loopback for same-device setups, and auto-connects when you tell it to (last used, LAN, or same device). - Navigation — the drawers work like Discord's: swipe right from the left edge for the workspace-grouped chat list, swipe left to close it, swipe left from the right edge for the session details panel. - Chat — streamed turns with reasoning disclosure, markdown, terminal/diff/read/search/web tool cards, a queue dock where you can edit, remove or steer a queued turn, history paging, and multi-photo and file attachments. Drafts are kept per host and session. - Workspace panels — tabbed text, Markdown, image, PDF and isolated HTML previews; native terminal controls with a bundled xterm renderer; archived-session restore in Settings. - Message feedback — confirmed ratings and retraction, with version-conflict handling. - Slash commands and skills — typing `/` lists the session's commands and skills above the composer. The composer checks a `/` line against the session's own command catalog and runs it through the harness's command gateway. Anything the catalog does not claim is sent as a prompt, which is how skills get invoked. With the dsh-rewind plugin on the host, `/rewind` opens a picker. - Everything the GUI does — goals (phases, rounds, pause/resume/edit), plan mode and plan review, permission approvals, user questions, todo dock, subagents (catalog, follow-ups, interrupt), background jobs, workflow runs, skills, model selection, agent presets, session search, trajectory ledger, session export, message feedback. - Notifications — turn complete, goal complete or blocked, review or question waiting for you. A foreground service keeps the connection alive in the background. - Harness look — the exact DeepSeek Harness design tokens (colors, type, radii, disclosure rows, shimmer, ink buttons), with light, dark and system themes. - 11 languages — English, 中文, हिन्दी, Español, Français, العربية, বাংলা, Português, Русский, اردو, ไทย (RTL aware). ### Added in 0.15.0 - A Check now button for updates in Settings > About. The automatic check also runs again when you come back to the app after a few hours. - Workspace links in replies drawn as file and folder pills; a folder opens in Files. - A redesigned Details panel, Workspace screen and Settings, with archived sessions on a tab of their own. ### Added in 0.14.0 - A `/` menu above the composer with the session's commands and skills. - A picker for the dsh-rewind plugin's `/rewind` and `/undo` that asks for confirmation before it restores files. The transcript hides what a rewind withdrew and marks the cut. ### Added in 0.13.0 - Automation catalog, timing edits, delivery history and session shortcuts. - Plugin installation, updates, toggles, removal, progress and recovery. Create plugin stages an unsent draft with the Creator preset when the host offers it. - Timed questions, continued replies, saved answer drafts and reopenable plans. - Draft text and file, folder and session references saved across app restarts. - Model search, YAML document properties and multiline goal editing. - Reverse-proxy path support and tool argument previews while the model is writing. ## Requirements - Android 8.0+ (minSdk 26). - A running [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) at `0.2.1-alpha.2`, the protocol baseline for DSH Mobile `0.16.0`. Existing protocol fallbacks remain for `0.2.0-rc.1`, `0.1.7-rc.x` and `0.1.6-alpha.x`; new management features need host support. See [compatibility](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) and the [0.13.0 validation status](docs/VALIDATION-0.13.0.md) for what has been checked on this baseline. ## Quick start 1. Install the latest APK from [Releases](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/releases/latest). 2. Open the app and choose how to connect.
